annotations.text: Upper spine of SUMO (Niles & Pease 2001): 43 subsumptions + 0 disjoints over 26 classes, depth ≤ 2 from Entity. SUMO's top is Sowa's ontology on Peirce's categories — Independent/Relative/Mediating = Firstness/Secondness/Thirdness, the Peircean triad at the root of a modern upper ontology.

Honest partial import: the full SUMO file yields {'subclass-of': 123, 'instance-of': 9} EG axioms; 181 forms were NOT translated because they are not first-order-EG-expressible — 89× documentation, 34× nth-domain, 8× =>, 8× and, 7× <=>, 4× subclass-of (variable/non-ground), 4× part-of, 3× =, 3× the, 2× forall, 2× or, 2× ?Z, 2× instance-of (variable/non-ground), 1× not, 1× in, 1× overlaps, 1× exists, 1× proper-part-of, 1× proper-overlaps, 1× interior-part-of, 1× superficial-part-of, 1× surface-of, 1× mereological-sum, 1× mereological-product, 1× mereological-difference, 1× Maximal-Boundary. Documentation strings are metadata; =>/<=>/nth-domain/modal forms exceed first-order EG. The displayed UoD is the depth≤2 upper spine for layout legibility; the full ground taxonomy (123 subsumptions) is reproducible via tools/suokif_to_eg.py.
